name: Select / AI Model Picker
description: AI Model Picker product scenario for the Select component.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

controls.name: error
controls.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Not a live region.

controls.name: labelPosition
controls.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Choices in list and keyboard order; an item repeating an earlier value is dropped.

controls.name: placeholder
controls.description: Text in the trigger while nothing is selected and `displayValue` is empty.

controls.name: displayValue
controls.description: Replaces the selected labels in the trigger, for example with a count or an icon.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disables the trigger and leaves the value out of FormData.

controls.name: name
controls.description: FormData key; a multiple value submits one entry per selected item.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Id of the form that submits and resets the value, when it is not an ancestor.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Blocks form submission until an item is selected and marks the label.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the field when there is no visible `label`, and then titles the sheet.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of elements that name the field; they take precedence over `label` and `aria-label`.

controls.name: iconOnly
controls.description: A square trigger without a chevron; name it with `aria-label`.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Fills the available inline width.

controls.name: stretchText
controls.description: Expands the value area so the chevron sits at the inline end.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Controlled list visibility; a disabled Select, or one without enabled items, stays closed.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: List visibility on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

controls.name: surface
controls.description: Where the list opens: auto is a popover, or a bottom sheet below 900px; side opens beside the trigger on hover or click.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Strings Select renders itself: `close` names the sheet's close button.

controls.name: contentMinWidth
controls.description: Minimum popover width in pixels or CSS length, capped by the viewport; side and sheet surfaces ignore it.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around the trigger and each item; toggling it keeps the trigger.

controls.name: multiple
controls.description: Lets the user select any number of items and makes the value a `string[]` instead of `string | null`; selecting then keeps the list open.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Selected value, or values with `multiple`; a value missing from `items` shows as unselected until it appears.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Selection on mount, restored by form reset; same shape as `value`.
